passages.context: Sections 2-3 were read in the complete Latin sermon. Section 2 contrasts the Pharisee's self-praise and insult with the publican's confession and pardon; section 3 argues that even the Pharisee's thanksgiving is proud because he seeks no further gift, then applies the parable against presumption on one's own strength.
passages.notes: The source page's internal file number 150 is not a sermon locus. This is modern Sermo 115, the same work numbered Sermon 65 in the older English New Testament series.
